cues.zh: 在分段函數邊界計算臨界值，需要小心，因為知道臨界點是零，

cues.en: But when you plug in zero, the answer is not zero.
cues.zh: 但代入零時，答案不是零。

cues.en: F of x does not equal zero at zero because this first piece is defined for negative numbers.
cues.zh: f(x) 在零不等於零，因為第一段定義在負數。

cues.en: So in fact, we have to apply this piece over here.
cues.zh: 所以其實需要用這一段。

cues.en: So when x equals zero, the function value actually equals one.
cues.zh: 當 x 等於零，函數值其實是 1。

cues.en: And that's what you see here.
cues.zh: 這裡就看得到。

cues.en: Similarly, when we see x is equal to three, then that actually does not correspond to ten.
cues.zh: 同樣地，x 等於 3 時，其實不對應 10。

cues.en: The function output is not ten when x equals three because this is an exclusive upper bound here.
cues.zh: x 等於 3 時，函數輸出不是 10，因為這裡的上界不包含。

cues.en: Instead, the function value is minus the natural log of.
cues.zh: 函數值反而是負的自然對數。

cues.en: And by the way, when you run into like a weird arithmetic expression like this, then just leave it written out like this.
cues.zh: 順便說，遇到這種奇怪的算術式，就保留這樣寫。

cues.en: Don't try to evaluate this and estimate it to some level of accuracy.
cues.zh: 不要試著求值，再估計到某個準確度。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And so here are the graphs of this function.
cues.zh: 這裡是函數的圖。

cues.en: You can see that the derivative is zero here, and it's never zero over here, and it's never zero over here.
cues.zh: 可以看到，導數這裡為零，這裡永遠不為零，這裡也永遠不為零。

cues.en: And we do have these two discontinuities.
cues.zh: 而我們確實有兩個不連續。

cues.en: There's one discontinuity in the function here, and there's another discontinuity here.
cues.zh: 函數在這裡有一個，這裡有另一個。

cues.en: Now, discontinuities are fine.
cues.zh: 不連續本身沒關係。

cues.en: The last point that I want to remind you of here is that a point is a critical point, only if the function is defined at that point.
cues.zh: 最後提醒，只有函數在該點有定義，這個點才能是臨界點。

cues.en: So imagine that instead of saying otherwise here, imagine that this case said if X is greater than three.
cues.zh: 想像這裡不是寫「其他情況」，而是寫「x 大於 3」。

cues.en: Now, if that were the case, if this had said X greater than three, then that would mean that the
cues.zh: 如果是這樣，寫的是 x 大於 3，就表示

cues.en: function is actually undefined at X equals exactly three.
cues.zh: 函數在 x 恰好等於 3 時，其實沒有定義。

cues.en: And if that were the case, if the function were undefined at exactly x equals three, then this point here is no longer a critical point.
cues.zh: 如果函數在恰好等於 3 時沒有定義，這個點就不再是臨界點。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。
